variablesInModel.Name: passing order of trains t and t' at a location
variablesInModel.Description: = 1 if train t blocks location l in L_t ∩ L_t' before train t' (Table A1); defined for one representative location per \hat{L}_{t,t',l} set, written y_{t,t',\hat{l}} in (17)-(18).

variablesInModel.Name: route assignment
variablesInModel.Description: = 1 if train t uses route r in R_t.

variablesInModel.Name: scheduled speed profile assignment
variablesInModel.Description: = 1 if train t runs according to the scheduled speed profile over speed assignment location l in P^r along route r in R_t (new in this paper).

variablesInModel.Name: maximum speed profile assignment
variablesInModel.Description: = 1 if train t runs according to the maximum speed profile over speed assignment location l in P^r along route r in R_t (new in this paper).

variablesInModel.Name: occupation starting time
variablesInModel.Description: Occupation starting time of train t on location l in L^r along route r in R_t; also used at parameter-given locations (sigma_{r,l}, ref^s, ref^m, l_inf), same family.

variablesInModel.Name: extended occupation time
variablesInModel.Description: Extended occupation time of train t between l and sigma_{r,l} along route r (dwell time, delay); the paper calls it an auxiliary timing variable, counted here as a decision-variable family.

variablesInModel.Name: blocking starting time
variablesInModel.Description: Time at which train t starts blocking location l in L_t (auxiliary timing variable). Table A1 lists b^s and b^e on one line; counted as two families.

variablesInModel.Name: blocking ending time
variablesInModel.Description: Time at which train t ends blocking location l in L_t (auxiliary timing variable).

variablesInModel.Name: final delay
variablesInModel.Description: Delay of train t when exiting the infrastructure and/or arriving at destination; a separate family from z_{t,s} (different index set and meaning).

variablesInModel.Name: delay at a scheduled stop
variablesInModel.Description: Delay of train t when stopping at station s in S_t.

objective_functions.Name: (2) weighted total delay plus speed penalty
objective_functions.equation: \text{minimise} \quad \sum_{t \in T} \big( w_t (z_t + \sum_{s \in S_t} z_{t,s}) + w \sum_{\substack{r \in R_t: \\ l \in \mathrm{P}^r}} v^{\mathrm{m}}_{t,r,l} \big).
objective_functions.description: Weighted delays at scheduled stops (z_{t,s}) and at exit (z_t), w_t per train, plus w times the number of maximum speed profiles assigned (v^m). Weights are parameters, so linear.

constraints.Name: (3) start no earlier than the initial entry time on the assigned route
constraints.equation: o_{t,r,l} \ge \mathit{init}_t \, x_{t,r} \qquad \forall t \in T,\ r \in R_t,\ l \in L^r,
constraints.description: Occupation starting time o at least init_t on the route with x_{t,r} = 1; parameter times binary, linear.

constraints.Name: (4) zero occupation times on unassigned routes
constraints.equation: o_{t,r,l} \le M \, x_{t,r} \qquad \forall t \in T,\ r \in R_t,\ l \in L^r,
constraints.description: Big-M bound: o is zero on routes not assigned to train t; linear.

constraints.Name: (5) one route per train
constraints.description: Exactly one route in R_t is assigned to each train.

constraints.Name: (6) one speed profile per speed assignment location
constraints.equation: v^{\mathrm{m}}_{t,r,l} + v^{\mathrm{s}}_{t,r,l} = x_{t,r} \qquad \forall t \in T,\ r \in R_t,\ l \in \mathrm{P}^r,
constraints.description: Maximum or scheduled speed profile on each speed assignment location of the assigned route, none on unassigned routes.

constraints.Name: (7) occupation starting time of the succeeding location
constraints.equation: o_{t,r,\sigma_{r,l}} = o_{t,r,l} + o^{+}_{t,r,l} + \mathit{rt}_{t,r,l} \, x_{t,r} + \mathit{\Delta rt}_{t,r,l} v^{\mathrm{s}}_{t,r,\rho_{r,l}} \qquad \forall t \in T,\ r \in R_t,\ l \in L^r,
constraints.description: o at sigma_{r,l} = o at l + extended occupation o^+ + running time, plus the additional running time when v^s at rho_{r,l} is 1. Both o terms are family 5.

constraints.Name: (8) dwell time in the extended occupation time
constraints.equation: o^{+}_{t,r,l} \ge \sum_{\substack{s \in S_t: \\ l \in S_{t,s} \cap L^r}} \mathit{dw}_{t,s} \, x_{t,r} \qquad \forall t \in T,\ r \in R_t,\ l \in \bigcup_{s \in S_t} L_{t,s},
constraints.description: o^+ covers the minimum dwell time at scheduled stops. The sum's condition is printed l in S_{t,s} ∩ L^r (L_{t,s} in (9)); kept as printed, no effect on structure.

constraints.Name: (9) no departure before the scheduled departure time
constraints.equation: o_{t,r,\sigma_{r,l}} \ge \sum_{\substack{s \in S_t: \\ l \in L_{t,s} \cap L^r}} d_{t,s} \, x_{t,r} \qquad \forall t \in T,\ r \in R_t,\ l \in \bigcup_{s \in S_t} L_{t,s},
constraints.description: o at the succeeding location sigma_{r,l} is at least the scheduled departure d_{t,s} on the assigned route.

constraints.Name: (10) delay at scheduled stops
constraints.equation: z_{t,s} \ge \sum_{r \in R_t} \sum_{l \in L^r \cap L_{t,s}} \big( o_{t,r,l} + \mathit{rt}_{r,t,l} x_{t,r} + \mathit{\Delta rt}_{t,r,l} v^{\mathrm{s}}_{t,r,\rho_{r,l}} \big) - a_{t,s} \qquad \forall t \in T, s \in S_t,
constraints.description: z_{t,s} at least arrival at the stopping location (o + running time, DTG term with v^s) minus a_{t,s}. Printed rt_{r,t,l} (index order differs from rt_{t,r,l}); kept as printed.

constraints.Name: (11) delay at exit or destination
constraints.description: z_t at least the occupation starting time at the dummy destination l_inf minus sched_t.

constraints.Name: (12) blocking start of track or first switch locations, scheduled-speed braking point
constraints.equation: b^s_{t,l} \le \sum_{r \in R_t: l \in L^r} (o_{t,r,ref^s_{t,r,l}} + (lag^s_{t,r,l} - for_{r,l}) x_{t,r}) \quad \forall t \in T, l \in L_t: s_l = 0 \lor \nexists r \in R_t: s_{\pi_{r,l}} = 1
constraints.description: b^s at most o at the reference location ref^s (a parameter index of o, still family 5) plus (lag^s - for) on the assigned route.

constraints.Name: (13) blocking start of track or first switch locations, maximum-speed braking point
constraints.equation: b^s_{t,l} \le \sum_{r \in R_t: l \in L^r} (o_{t,r,ref^m_{t,r,l}} + (lag^m_{t,r,l} - for_{r,l}) x_{t,r} + M v^s_{t,r,\rho_{r,ref^s_{t,r,l}}}) \quad \forall t \in T, l \in L_t: s_l = 0 \lor ...
constraints.description: As (12) with ref^m and lag^m, plus big-M term M v^s (linear). Nested ref^s printed with an italic s. Quantifier abbreviated in this field.

constraints.Name: (14) blocking start of other switch locations, scheduled-speed braking point
constraints.equation: b^s_{t,l} \le \sum_{r \in R_t: l \in L^r} (o_{t,r,ref^s_{t,r,\pi_{r,l}}} + (lag^s_{t,r,\pi_{r,l}} - for_{r,\pi_{r,l}}) x_{t,r} \quad \forall t \in T, l \in L_t: s_l = 1 \land \exists r \in R_t: s_{\pi_{r,l}} = 1
constraints.description: (12) for the preceding location pi_{r,l}. The closing big parenthesis is missing in the paper; transcribed as printed.

constraints.Name: (15) blocking start of other switch locations, maximum-speed braking point
constraints.equation: b^s_{t,l} \le \sum_{r \in R_t: l \in L^r} (o_{t,r,ref^m_{t,r,\pi_{r,l}}} + (lag^m_{t,r,\pi_{r,l}} - for_{r,\pi_{r,l}}) x_{t,r} + M v^s_{t,r,\rho_{r,ref^s_{t,r,\pi_{r,l}}}}) \quad \forall t, l: s_l = 1 \land ...
constraints.description: (13) for the preceding location pi_{r,l}; big-M term M v^s (linear). Quantifier abbreviated in this field.

constraints.Name: (16) blocking end time
constraints.equation: b^e_{t,l} = \sum_{r \in R_t: l \in L^r} (o_{t,r,\sigma_{r,l}} + (ct_{t,r,l} + rel_{r,l}) x_{t,r} + \Delta ct_{t,r,l} v^s_{t,r,\rho_{r,l}} + \sum_{l' \in L^r: l' \in OL_{t,r,l}} o^+_{t,r,l'}) \quad \forall t \in T, l \in L_t
constraints.description: b^e = o at sigma_{r,l} + (ct + rel) x + DTG clearing term with v^s + o^+ over OL_{t,r,l}. Printed ct_{t,r,l}; Sect. 4.2.1 names it cl_{t,r,l}.

constraints.Name: (17) no overlap of blocking times, t before t'
constraints.equation: b^{\mathrm{e}}_{t,l} - M \, (1 - y_{t,t',\hat{l}}) \le b^{\mathrm{s}}_{t',l} \qquad \forall t, t' \in T, \text{index}\ t < \text{index}\ t',\ l, \hat{l} \in L_t \cap L_{t'} : l \in \hat{L}_{t,t',\hat{l}},
constraints.description: Disjunctive big-M: with y = 1 the blocking of t ends before t' starts. y is written with the representative location \hat{l}; same family as y_{t,t',l}.

constraints.Name: (18) no overlap of blocking times, t' before t
constraints.equation: b^{\mathrm{e}}_{t',l} - M \, y_{t,t',\hat{l}} \le b^{\mathrm{s}}_{t,l} \qquad \forall t, t' \in T, \text{index}\ t < \text{index}\ t',\ l, \hat{l} \in L_t \cap L_{t'} : l \in \hat{L}_{t,t',\hat{l}}.
constraints.description: Disjunctive big-M counterpart of (17) for y = 0.
